title: Book Two · Chapter 133: A Hole in the Pocket
story:
One afternoon, Ronan loses a coin on the way home. At Mr Qiu's table, he reaches into his pocket. The coin is gone. He puts a finger through the hole in his pocket.

“My money has a door,” he says.

Mr Qiu looks down. “An open one.”

Ronan searches the path between the corner and the gate. He finds a leaf, a small stone, and a button. None of them will buy a pencil.

He leaves the button on the wall beside the gate. Someone may come to look for it. Then he goes indoors.

Mum is finishing a customer's sleeve.

“I need a pocket repair,” Ronan says.

“Put the trousers here after supper.”

“Can I try?”

Mum looks at the hole. It is small and away from the main seam.

“Yes. I can show you. I need to finish this first.”

Ronan changes into his other trousers. He waits with a book until the sleeve is done.

Mum brings a needle and thread to the clear table. She shows him a short line of stitches on spare cloth. Then he tries his pocket. His first stitch catches the other side.

“Now it is a locked room,” Mum says.

Ronan laughs. He pulls the thread back carefully. Mum watches his hands.

The next stitches stay on the torn edge. They are not neat, but the hole closes. He makes a small knot at the end. Mum checks it before he puts the needle away.

“Will it hold?”

“For a coin, yes. Not for bricks.”

“I will keep my bricks somewhere else.”

Dad comes home while they are still at the table. Ronan shows him the pocket.

“A new skill,” Dad says.

“A one-coin skill.”

“That is a useful size.”

After supper, Ronan puts a coin into the pocket. He walks around the room, sits down, and stands again. The coin stays.

He wants to call it perfect. Then he feels a little piece of thread against his leg.

“Good enough for this,” he says.

Mum clips the loose end. The pocket feels smooth now.

The next morning, Mr Qiu has a coin beside his box. A woman found it near the corner.

“Where did you lose your coin?” he asks Ronan. “What kind of coin was it?”

Ronan answers. The coin matches.

“Your door needs a key,” Mr Qiu says.

“It has stitches now.”

Ronan shows him the repaired pocket. He keeps the coin in his closed hand until he reaches school. There he puts it inside the small inner pocket of his bag.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

pocket＝口袋；stitch＝针脚；seam＝接缝；knot＝结。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan第一次缝补造成什么小笑话？
2. 为什么Mr Qiu先问清丢钱信息再还钱？

## 读句子

**The coin / stays.** 硬币／留在原处。
